heuristic”与通风-外形复用机制","mechanism_claim_zh":"这里的关键不是“第四烟囱是假的”这类换名，而是早期远洋客轮把乘客对 funnel 数量的速度/安全直觉，与机舱和附属空间的通风需求，合并进同一个高可见度构件里；于是第四个 funnel 的 Olympic-class 结构与总布置图","Mark Chirnside, The Olympic-Class Ships","Illustrated London News 对 Olympic/Titanic 第四 funnel 通风用途的图解资料"]},{"seed_id":"S2","source_anchor_quote_en":"were below the deep load Coast Guard Load Line guidance","International Convention on Load Lines (ICLL) / freeboard 条文与技术手册","SNAME 或同类 naval architecture 教材中关于 side discharges 与 shell openings Built steel chocks were also fitted to prevent movement fore and aft.","external_lens_identity":"marine boiler seating中的“允许热膨胀、限制惯性位移”安装机制","mechanism_claim_zh":"这里的支承不是单纯“固定得更牢”，而是分方向管理不同载荷：横向 stays 抵抗横摇与侧向惯性，前后 chocks 抵抗纵向冲击/碰撞位移，而 boiler foundation 还必须给受热膨胀留出条件。也就是说，锅炉座设计是在“可伸缩”和“不可乱跑”之间做约束分解。","reread_delta_zh":"重读后，cradles、stays、chocks 不再是三个并列零件名，而是一套按载荷方向拆分功能的安装逻辑；这让原文的结构细节 suddenly 变得可计算、可验证。","source_leads":["46 CFR 52.01-130 Installation（boiler foundations, expansion, chocks）","maritime.org 的 shipyard / engineering training material 中 boiler chocks 与 foundations 词条","传统 marine engineering 教材中 boiler seating / bracing 章节"]},{"seed_id":"S4","source_anchor_quote_en":"Silent blow-offs from the main steam pipes were connected direct to both condensers.","external_lens_identity":"marine steam plant中的 condenser steam-dump / closed blow-off arrangement","mechanism_claim_zh":"“silent”指向的不是修辞，而是把本可直接向大气喷放的高压蒸汽，导入 condenser 做闭式冷凝与消声；这样既减小噪声和甲板危险，也可维持蒸汽回路的受控卸压。连接到 both condensers 说明它被纳入双路冷凝能力，而非临时排空。","reread_delta_zh":"重读后，这句从一个附件连接说明，变成了整套蒸汽系统运转哲学的线索：该船并不把 blow-off 当作简单放空，而是当作需要被冷凝器吸收和管理的系统事件。","source_leads":["DNV / class rules 中 condenser overpressure 与 steam dump arrangements","merchant marine engineering training texts on condensers and auxiliary exhaust systems","早期 marine engineering manuals 中关于 steam drains/blow-offs led to condensers 的章节"]}]}}
